annotations.text:
Sijil IT — 10 screens + a token sheet.

Every colour, size, radius and weight is lifted from lib/app/theme (navy #16255C, mint #2FE3A8, surface #F5F7FB, Plus Jakarta Sans, Material 3), so these are buildable as-is.

Static mockups, light mode. Dark mode falls out of the same tokens — AppTheme.dark is already defined.

Row 1 — first run and the two core screens.

Row 2 — the asset workflows: detail, assign, return, scan.

Row 3 — people, system settings, and the token sheet to build against.

Status is resolved, not stored: Available / Assigned / Maintenance / Retired come from standard Odoo fields.

Reserved, Damaged and Lost have no standard field, so they carry the small phone icon meaning "kept on this device" — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §6.
